blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `maybeUnsetDefaultShippingAddressesStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step unsets the `is_default_billing` property of existing customer addresses
if the `is_default_billing` property in the addresses in the input is set to `true`.

children.name: MaybeUnsetDefaultShippingAddressesStepInput
children.description: The addresses being created or updated.
